# Briopost

> Briopost is a creative studio for LinkedIn, opening soon. It turns one idea into a carousel, graphic, text post or poll in the user's own voice and brand. Nothing posts to LinkedIn without the user's OK. Free during the beta, with AI credits included. Made by Briopost LLC. Independent of LinkedIn: not affiliated with or endorsed by LinkedIn.

## What it does

- Start with notes, a link, a document or a rough thought.
- Pick a format: a carousel, a graphic, a text post or a poll.
- Make it yours: your colors, your fonts and your voice. Edit every slide in a real editor, starting from built-in templates.
- Plan the month on a calendar.
- You approve: every post waits until you confirm it, then it posts at the time you choose.

## Facts

- Status: not open yet. Invites go out first, then Briopost opens to everyone. People can join the waitlist on the home page.
- Cost: the beta is free. Pricing will be shared before anyone pays.
- AI: AI is included and paid for with monthly AI credits (the beta includes credits). Before each AI action, Briopost shows its cost in credits. A cheaper plan will let the user bring their own Claude, OpenAI or fal key instead.
- Who it is for: consultants and coaches, founders and business owners, marketers and agencies, and job seekers who post on LinkedIn.
- Contact: info@briopost.com
